scientific_integrity: The published scheme, local stability derivative, and numerical oscillation observations are attributed to their originators. The claim concerns the critical global inverse-time law and quantitative existence, local stability, onset, and stiff-limit behavior of an exact postcritical cycle. No independent validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Proved for exactly symmetric, two-state bidirectional linear exchange with strictly positive initial data, the unmodified second-order GeCo2 update and exact arithmetic. Only local attraction of the supercritical two-cycle is established. Priority remains subject to further inspection of inaccessible and uncatalogued literature.
title: A critical inverse-time law and an attracting two-cycle at every supercritical GeCo2 step
